title: EmDash: a brief with no language chosen sends the personalize tool no language, so no locale is hidden
steps: S1: Run node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/brief-emdash.test.mjs from the repository root.
S2: The LANG-5 test compiles a brief whose language answer is blank and reads the questionnaire handed to the tool.
expect: S1: the named test reports ok.
S2: the questionnaire carries no language field, so the tool hides no locale the template ships.
evidence: The EmDash brief engine sent the normalizer's fallback English as if the customer had picked it, so a blank Tracy Business build still unpublished 1911 entries of 39 locales (commit df121b9a0, #1013).
fence: The EmDash engine sending a language to the tool only when the customer chose one.

tests: LANG-5: a brief with no language chosen sends the tool no language, so it hides no locale
